description: This file defines the ShoppingCartAttributeItem class, which models an item representing a product attribute within a shopping cart. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping, contains references to product attributes and shopping cart items, and implements auditing features.

classes.name: ShoppingCartAttributeItem
classes.description: Entity class representing an attribute item associated with a shopping cart item, including fields for product attribute, shopping cart, and audit information.

methods.name: ShoppingCartAttributeItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing the attribute item with a shopping cart item and a product attribute.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Returns the associated shopping cart item.

methods.name: setShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Sets the associated shopping cart item.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section for auditing purposes.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section for this entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the entity.
